en.basel-kadem: 1.	We were told by Abu’l-Hasan, Muhammed bin Ahmad bin Ali al-Asadi, that he said: We were told by Abdullah bin Muhammed bin Mir-Zaban, that he said: We were told by Ali bin Ja’d, that he said: We were informed by Shu’ba, from Abu Imran al-Jouni, from Abdullah bin Samit, that he said: Abu Dharr, upon whom is the mercy of Allah, said:
I said: O Messenger of Allah, a man would act for himself and the people would leave him. He said: That is the hasting good news for a believer.
